name: ai-red-mahjong
description: 可在浏览器游玩的四人红中麻将

scripts.dev:online: vite build --config server/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config server/wrangler.jsonc --local --port 8787
scripts.build:online: vite build --config server/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:online: npm run typecheck:online && vite build --config server/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:online:smoke: vite build --config server/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner && node scripts/online-smoke.mjs
